title: AI Kissing Video Generator
summary: Make an AI kissing video from one photo of a couple: the kiss AI effect, the exact prompts behind it and six example clips to copy. Free to try in Flick.
body_markdown:
### How do I make an AI kissing video from a photo?


Upload a photo of the two people side by side with both faces visible as the start frame of an image to video model, describe them turning to each other and sharing a soft kiss with a static camera, and generate a short clip.


### Is there a free AI kissing video generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, enough to animate a photo of a couple into a short kissing clip.


### Can I make an AI kiss video from two separate photos?


Yes. Generate or edit one picture that puts both people side by side in the same place and light first, then animate that picture, because the kiss looks natural when both faces start in one frame.


### What kind of photo works best for kiss AI?


A sharp, well lit photo of two people standing or sitting close together, waist up, both facing the camera with their faces fully visible works best, because the model needs to see both faces to turn them toward each other.


### Whose photos can I use for an AI kissing video?


Use a photo of yourself and your partner, of people who agreed to it, or of characters you generated yourself, and never a photo of a celebrity, a stranger or anyone under 18.


### How do I keep the faces the same in an AI kissing video?


Keep the movement simple, keep the camera still, and end the prompt with same couple, same clothes, same place, then generate again if either face changes during the turn.


### Can I add music to an AI kissing video?


Yes. Make the clip first, then add a song when you post it, or generate a music track in Flick to go with it, and line the kiss up with a soft moment in the music.
